texts.content_exam: Telekinesis is simply the ability to move an object in some manner without coming into physical contact with it. In 1960, a Russian housewife videoed herself moving the tableware by just looking at it. She could also break an egg and separate the white from the yolk without touching it. She accidently discovered her ability to do so. Another Cuban youngman called Khwan used to work as a clerk in a gift shop. He coincidently discovered that he had a supernatural power and that he could move the cups on the shelves and make them fly. He used to do that sitting behind his desk.

📝 الترجمة: التحريك عن بعد هو القدرة على تحريك جسم دون لمسه.
💡 الشرح: النص يقول: 'Telekinesis is simply the ability to move an object in some manner without coming into physical contact with it.'

💡 الشرح: النص يقول: 'a Russian housewife videoed herself moving the tableware by just looking at it.'

texts.content_exam: One explanation to the mentioned phenomenon is related to the magnetic field which can occur when a human being is in control of it. So, they can push that field into a certain object causing it to move. Scientists also said that emotional states especially anger can affect an external environment and this could be clearly seen in all the movies which were made about this phenomenon. Logically speaking, there are no supernatural powers. In fact, there are powers that we don't know how to use. Such powers are similar to life skills which are learnt daily; they are similar to how children learn to hold things, to read and write. The more we practice the more we achieve.

texts.content_exam: People sometimes experience new events and have a strange feeling that it's not the first time. This sensation is called déjà vu. Déjà vu or "already seen" is one of the human supernatural powers which results from the subconscious. Some researchers believe that déjà vu is our memory about dreams. This means that you did not face the situation before, but you had seen it in one of your dreams! Of course you don't remember the dream, but when you face the situation you recall that dream and you are shocked, yet you don't remember when or where exactly you saw it before.

questions.question: People sometimes experience new events and have a strange feeling that it's ........ the first time.
questions.explanation:
✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: not
📝 الترجمة: يشعر الناس أحياناً بأنه ليست المرة الأولى.
💡 الشرح: النص يقول: 'have a strange feeling that it's not the first time.'

questions.question: Déjà vu is one of the human supernatural powers which results from the ........ .
questions.explanation:
✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: subconscious
📝 الترجمة: الديجافو هو أحد القوى الخارقة التي تنتج عن العقل الباطن.
💡 الشرح: النص يقول: 'which results from the subconscious.'

questions.question: Some researchers believe that déjà vu is our memory about ........ .
questions.explanation:
✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: dreams
📝 الترجمة: يعتقد بعض الباحثين أن الديجافو هو ذاكرتنا عن الأحلام.
💡 الشرح: النص يقول: 'Some researchers believe that déjà vu is our memory about dreams.'

questions.explanation:
✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: recall
📝 الترجمة: لا تتذكر الحلم، ولكن عندما تواجه الموقف تسترجع ذلك الحلم.
💡 الشرح: النص يقول: 'you recall that dream.'

questions.question: Déjà vu means ........ .
questions.explanation:
✅ الإجابة الصحيحة: already seen
📝 الترجمة: الديجافو تعني 'شوهد سابقاً'.
💡 الشرح: النص يقول: 'Déjà vu or "already seen"'.

texts.content_exam: Other scientists say that the embryo sees his whole life when it is still in his mother's womb, and so it feels déjà vu as a recall from his memories. About 60 to 70% of people report having déjà vu, and it is more common in younger people, Giordano, a professor of neurology, says: "We experience the most déjà vu between the periods of 15 and 25". If you experience déjà vu a lot that means that you are young. While you can't say that as you get older your chances to experience déjà vu will vanish, you should definitely enjoy it when it appears. It is really a remarkable phenomenon that shouldn't just be dismissed.

💡 الشرح: النص يقول: 'the embryo sees his whole life when it is still in his mother's womb.'

💡 الشرح: النص يقول: 'We experience the most déjà vu between the periods of 15 and 25.'
